subject.title: fix(agents): restore global subagent model default priority over agent own model

question: Should isolated cron primary and fallback selection follow the documented global-subagent-default precedence already merged for normal subagent spawn planning?
rationale: Current main contains two explicit but conflicting merged contracts, and choosing one changes existing users' model/provider routing on upgrade.

options.title: Unify on documented precedence
options.body: Make every native subagent path use per-agent subagent model, then global subagent default, then agent/caller inheritance, coordinating persisted-session behavior separately.

options.title: Keep a cron-specific exception
options.body: Preserve agent-primary precedence for isolated cron and fallback policy, then document and test that exception in the public references.

recommendation.title: Unify on documented precedence
recommendation.body: Make every native subagent path use per-agent subagent model, then global subagent default, then agent/caller inheritance, coordinating persisted-session behavior separately.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the merged shared cron/fallback refactor whose current precedence this PR changes and has the strongest recent history across the affected files.
